answer_2.quote: The calibration performance of models was assessed through two metrics: the Brier Score (BS) and our proposed Upper Bound Calibration Error (UBCE).

answer_3.quote: CCTP quantifies the confidence of an answer by querying the model to verify the correctness of the answer. VCAA quantifies the confidence of an answer by querying the model to state its confidence.
